_help: categories: an item is listed under the FIRST category (in this order) whose terms it matches, so specific categories come before broad ones.
terms: words/phrases matched against titles and IA subject tags; write "double quotes" inside the string for an exact phrase.
example / contributes: what to collect and why (documentation only; the search ignores them).

optional per category: subject_tags (IA tags only), exclude (title words that rule an item out), candidates, min_minutes, max_minutes, from_date, to_date (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD), stations (channel identifier prefixes), max_mb.
the category name becomes the corpus/<category>/ folder.

meeting.example: A city council meeting discussing a redevelopment proposal
meeting.contributes: Multiple speakers, voting, presentations, audience reactions

discussion.example: A moderated panel discussing housing affordability
discussion.contributes: Multiple speakers, disagreement, turn-taking, group interactions

interview.example: A local entrepreneur interviewed on a morning television programme
interview.contributes: Questions, answers, close-ups, studio shots, guest interactions

presentation.example: A university researcher giving a public talk about climate change
presentation.contributes: Speaker, slides, graphs, audience questions, visual aids

news.example: A reporter covering flooding in a local neighbourhood
news.contributes: On-location reporting, environmental conditions, interviews, B-roll

performance.example: A local theatre company's ballet or musical production
performance.contributes: Dancing, gestures, stage lighting, costumes, camera framing

demonstration.example: A local chef demonstrating how to prepare a traditional dish
demonstration.contributes: Sequential actions, object manipulation, tools, close-up shots

guide.example: A community programme explaining how recycling works

documentary.example: A documentary about the history of a local neighbourhood
documentary.contributes: Archival footage, narration, interviews, historical locations

event.example: Coverage of a community cultural festival
event.contributes: Crowds, outdoor locations, multiple activities, changing scenes
